fee_notes: Royalty is 8% of Gross Sales, due monthly on the 5th of the following month. Brand Fund contribution is 1% of Gross Sales. National Account Fee is an additional 10% of Gross Sales earned from National Account facilities, payable for the first 12 months of servicing each facility (after 12 months, only the standard Royalty applies to that facility). Technology fee is currently ~$700/month (assuming 1 owner, 1 salesperson, 1 driver, 1 truck); increases with additional users/trucks; may increase up to 10% per year. Advertising Cooperative contributions may be required up to 2% of Gross Sales if a Cooperative is established. Management fee of 3% of Gross Sales plus direct costs applies only if franchisor manages the Business. No minimum monthly royalty floor disclosed.
